practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Single behavior per test. EVALUATION: test0 performs a single Act (new Grafo()) and a single assertion. DECISION: Only one method call and one Arrange-Act-Assert block present. VERDICT: compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should be independent. EVALUATION: Class declares @Before and @After and test0 uses only local variables; no shared mutable state visible. DECISION: presence of @Before/@After and no shared state => compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Coverage of Normal and Exceptional Flows
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Provide happy path and error cases. EVALUATION: Only one test method present covering the happy path; no exception tests or assertThrows. DECISION: Class has < 2 tests and no exception coverage -> non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Test boundary inputs where relevant. EVALUATION: The test exercises a constructor with no numeric/string input; no obvious boundary conditions to check. DECISION: For a simple default-constructor scenario boundary analysis is not applicable -> not-applicable.
PRINCIPLE: Reuse helpers and avoid duplication. EVALUATION: Single short test (<10 lines) with no duplicated code; no helper needed. DECISION: Tests are short and self-contained -> compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Detailed Analysis of Size and Complexity
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Keep tests small and simple. EVALUATION: test0 is short (<20 lines) linear, no loops or complex conditionals. DECISION: meets size/complexity criteria -> compliant.
PRINCIPLE: Assertions should verify multiple properties. EVALUATION: test0 contains a single superficial assertion (assertNotNull). DECISION: Only one assertion (assertNotNull) -> non-compliant.
PRINCIPLE: Avoid ignored or commented-out tests. EVALUATION: No @Ignore/@Disabled annotations or commented-out @Test; test0 is active. DECISION: No ignored/commented tests -> compliant.
PRINCIPLE: Link tests to requirements. EVALUATION: Method Javadoc includes 'Tests REQ-001: ...' providing requirement traceability. DECISION: Presence of requirement ID in comment -> compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Rigorous Use of Performance and Security Tests
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Non-functional tests when relevant. EVALUATION: The test uses @Test(timeout = 4000) (an explicit timeout). DECISION: Timeout present indicates a performance-related assertion -> compliant.
PRINCIPLE: Descriptive test names. EVALUATION: Method name is 'test0' which is generic and does not describe scenario/expected outcome. DECISION: Generic name -> non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Small Footprint of Test Code Generation
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Avoid heavy auto-generated verbose tests. EVALUATION: File header indicates 'This file was automatically generated by EvoSuite' and class uses EvoRunner; signs of generated code. DECISION: Presence of auto-generated header and generator-specific runner -> non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Prioritization of Test Case Design
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Thoughtful test design (Given-When-Then). EVALUATION: Method Javadoc includes Given/When/Then sections indicating design intent. DECISION: Presence of scenario documentation -> compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Responsible Addition of Test Code Maintenance
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should use public APIs and avoid brittle internals. EVALUATION: test0 uses public constructor and public observable APIs (assertNotNull/toString/getClass in suggested fixes); no reflection. DECISION: Only public API used -> compliant.
PRINCIPLE: Use clear, specific assertions with messages. EVALUATION: assertNotNull includes a descriptive failure message. DECISION: Specific assertion with message present -> compliant.
PRINCIPLE: Comments should add value. EVALUATION: Inline comments explain verification intent without excessive clutter; no commented-out code. DECISION: Minimal, useful comments -> compliant.
PRINCIPLE: Avoid non-determinism. EVALUATION: test0 uses no Random, no current time, no Thread.sleep; deterministic constructor use. DECISION: No sources of non-determinism present -> compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests must not leave side effects. EVALUATION: setUp/tearDown are empty, test0 uses only local objects and performs no persistence or static mutation. DECISION: No side effects detected -> compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Suitable Utilization of Test Labels and Categories
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Use tags/categories to organize tests. EVALUATION: Class declares @Category(UnitTest.class). DECISION: Category annotation present at class level -> compliant.

practices_report.description: Each test should focus on a single behavior and have one Arrange-Act-Assert block.
Tests must not depend on other tests or shared mutable state without proper setup/teardown.

practices_report.practice_title: Coverage of Normal and Exceptional Flows
practices_report.description: Provide tests for both happy path and error scenarios (exceptions, invalid inputs).
Test minimum, maximum and just-outside boundary values where applicable.
Extract repeated setup into helpers and use constants to reduce duplication.

practices_report.practice_title: Detailed Analysis of Size and Complexity
practices_report.description: Keep tests small (<20 lines) and avoid loops/complex conditionals.
Assertions should verify multiple properties to increase fault detection.
Avoid @Ignore/@Disabled and commented-out tests; keep tests active.
Link tests to requirements via annotations or Javadoc (REQ-, US-, JIRA- IDs).

practices_report.practice_title: Rigorous Use of Performance and Security Tests
practices_report.description: Include explicit performance/security tests when relevant (timeouts, auth checks).
Test names should describe scenario and expected outcome.

practices_report.practice_title: Small Footprint of Test Code Generation
practices_report.description: Avoid verbose auto-generated tests; prefer concise, intention-revealing tests.

practices_report.practice_title: Complete Prioritization of Test Case Design
practices_report.description: Design tests with Given-When-Then or BDD-style intent and prioritize scenarios.

practices_report.practice_title: Responsible Addition of Test Code Maintenance
practices_report.description: Tests should focus on public behavior and avoid brittle implementation details.
Use specific assertions with descriptive messages where helpful.
Use minimal, value-adding comments that explain 'why', not 'what'.
Avoid randomness, time-dependence, sleeps, and external dependencies without mocks.

practices_report.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects
practices_report.description: Ensure tests clean up resources and do not persist shared state across tests.

practices_report.practice_title: Suitable Utilization of Test Labels and Categories
practices_report.description: Use @Tag/@Category to organize and enable selective execution of tests.
